title: Finite record-reading machine
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with $k+2$ work tapes and record states consisting of a halting state or a cursor position and a Boolean record of length $4k+4$. Its underlying machine is the record-reading machine, and its state set is finite with decidable equality.
caveat: Finiteness and decidable equality follow from the record-state type's supplied construction, but that construction is represented here only as an abbreviation.
